sources.shuttle: Delhi Airport Inter-Terminal Shuttle Service (newdelhiairport.in), retrieved 2026-11-02

notes: OpenStreetMap is the source of terminal footprints, mapped gates and named facilities.
Each terminal uses an inferred central hall, gate spine, entrance and access connectors because indoor corridors are not mapped consistently.
All OSM-derived features are unverified. All derived connectors are inferred and drawn as dashed lines.
Inter-terminal shuttle existence and stop directions come from the airport source; the schematic connector geometry is straight-line, not OSRM.
